blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — The Department of Human Settlements and Urban Development (DHSUD) turned over 190 housing units to the local government of Caoayan in Ilocos Sur, providing permanent shelter for families displaced by the earthquake and successive typhoons that struck the province in 2022. Some of the beneficiaries received their units during a turnover and awarding ceremony on Thursday (October 29) and are set to relocate to their permanent homes at the Caoayan Resettlement Project in Barangay Villamar.
